acceptance: The leaking test or fixture is identified with a reproducer (command and ordering) that fails before the fix and passes after.
The root cause is fixed rather than masked: no retry decorator, skip, or loosened assertion is added to the BigQuery tests.
The BigQuery credential-defaults tests and their sibling credential tests pass 20 consecutive full-suite xdist runs with the CI worker count.
A regression test or fixture guard fails if a test leaves rich.prompt.Confirm or the credentials modules rebound after it runs.
The stale explanatory comment in test_bigquery_defaults.py is updated to describe the real cause and the guard.
context: Created as a follow-up while clearing a PR backlog. No fix applied; the flake was rerun, not repaired, on the affected PRs.
description:
Tests in tests/unit/platforms/credentials/test_bigquery_defaults.py (class TestBigQueryCredentialDefaults) fail intermittently in the `test (ubuntu-latest, 3.12)` CI job and pass when the file, or the whole tests/unit/scripts and credentials scope, runs locally. Because `test` feeds the required `core` unit, a flake here fails a PR's checks and fails the merge-queue group it is in, which ejects the PR (reason `failed_checks`) and forces a rerun.

Observed failures, both in the full-suite xdist run (worker gw0), on unrelated code changes:
- test_skips_auto_detection_when_credentials_exist: `assert mock_confirm.call_count == 1` -> `AssertionError: assert 0 == 1` (CI run 36865382651).
- test_works_with_no_existing_credentials: `calls[2][1]["current_value"]` at test_bigquery_defaults.py:134 -> `IndexError: list index out of range`, so fewer prompt calls were recorded than the setup flow makes (CI run 36910191689, job 110531036486).

Both match the failure mode already described in the comment at the top of the test class: another test file on the same xdist worker replaces the global `rich.prompt.Confirm`, so the test patches a stale object while production code calls the real prompt. That comment's mitigation (patching `benchbox.platforms.credentials.bigquery.Confirm.ask` instead of `rich.prompt.Confirm.ask`) is in place and the flake persists, so the root cause is not removed.

Leads:
- Sibling credential tests still patch `rich.prompt.Confirm.ask` globally (test_databricks_defaults.py, test_redshift_defaults.py, and others); check whether they or any other test rebinds or reloads `rich.prompt` or `benchbox.platforms.credentials.bigquery` without restoring it.
- Look for module reloads, `sys.modules` edits, or `importlib.reload` in the unit suite that leave `benchbox.platforms.credentials.bigquery.Confirm` bound to a different object than the one the tests patch.
- Reproduce with a pinned xdist ordering (`-p xdist -n 2 --dist loadfile` or the CI worker count and seed) and bisect which co-scheduled test file causes it.
